title: Explicit image of all Frobenius translates
statement: In an abelian category A with integer coproducts and additive autoequivalence F, let L:B→A be left adjoint to P:A→B. For an invertible F-algebra V, an object M of B, and s:M→P(V.carrier), define saturationMap as Free.desc V applied to the adjoint of s. Define saturation as its categorical image, saturationι as its image inclusion, and saturationUnit as the adjunction unit followed by the zero-th coprojection and the image quotient. The inclusion is monic and saturationUnit followed by P(saturationι) equals s. An underlying factor of an equivariant map through an equivariant monomorphism is itself equivariant. All objects and maps are explicitly constructed. For an exact functor Q between invertible-algebra categories whose carrier is P by a specified natural isomorphism, if the canonical generator for a monomorphism i is epi, restriction of its explicit saturation is isomorphic to the source of i and its inclusion factors as this isomorphism followed by i. This factorization descends to full subcategories using their specified natural inclusion comparison.

proof.text: In the abstract categories, the canonical generator is mono because its composite is i, and is epi by hypothesis. Lift it to an equivariant isomorphism by cancellation and invert it. The factorization equation descends to full subcategories by naturality of their specified inclusion comparison. Keeping this assembly abstract avoids unfolding large native category constructions in consumers.
